title: everyday parts: a hinge, a gear blank, a sheet metal box, a pipe elbow, a bottle, a handle, counterbored holes, a drafted block

cases.name: c001
cases.description: a hinge leaf: a 40 × 20 × 2 plate with a knuckle (a tube of radius 3 round a pin hole of radius 1.5) along its far edge, two screw holes (radius 1.5), its free corners rounded 3

cases.name: c002
cases.description: a gear blank: a disc (radius 20, 6 thick) with a tooth (a 4 × 3 block) on its rim patterned 12 round it, a bore (radius 5) through, its faces' bore edges chamfered 0.5

cases.name: c003
cases.description: a sheet metal box: a 40 × 30 plate (1.5 thick, bends of radius 1) with flanges 15 up on all four edges, its corners closed by default, a hole (radius 4) in its floor

cases.name: c004
cases.description: a pipe elbow: a circle (radius 5) swept round a quarter arc of radius 20, shelled 1 mm open at both ends, a flange (radius 9, 2 thick) on each end

cases.name: c005
cases.description: a bottle: a profile (body radius 15, 40 tall, a shoulder up to a neck of radius 6 that is 10 tall) revolved, its foot filleted 3, shelled 1 open at its neck

cases.name: c006
cases.description: a handle: a circle (radius 2.5) swept along a three-point arc from (0, 0, 0) through (15, 0, 12) to (30, 0, 0), standing on a 40 × 10 × 3 plate, united

cases.name: c007
cases.description: a 80 × 20 × 8 plate with a counterbored hole (6 through, counterbore 10 × 4) at (10, 10), patterned 4 along x at 20 mm

cases.name: c008
cases.description: a 40 × 30 × 20 block, its four sides drafted 3° from its bottom, a boss (radius 5, 8 tall) on its top, filleted 1 at its foot
